title: Customer state update blocked by open PostgreSQL transaction
customer_impact: A customer state update does not complete while database health checks and unrelated reads remain available.
scope: The degradation is isolated to a row-level update path for customer-0042; PostgreSQL remains reachable and there is no database-wide outage.

timeline.event: Customer state update reported as hanging while general database health remained green.
L2 acknowledged the P3 degradation and verified PostgreSQL reachability before changing runtime state.
pg_stat_activity showed the affected session waiting on a Lock event while another tagged transaction remained open.
pg_blocking_pids and pg_locks established the exact waiter-to-blocker relationship and target row-lock context.
Approved simulated recovery terminated only the proven opsforge-db002-blocker backend.
Waiting transaction completed, lock wait cleared, and the expected customer state update was verified.

evidence: PostgreSQL remained reachable during the blocked update
pg_blocking_pids mapped the waiter to the tagged simulated blocker
pg_locks captured granted and waiting lock state before recovery
blocker backend identity and query were captured before termination
only the proven simulated blocker backend was terminated
waiting update completed after lock release
no DB-002 blocker or waiter sessions remained after recovery
resolution: After L2 proved the exact blocker/waiter relationship and captured lock evidence, the approved simulated recovery terminated only the tagged blocking backend. The waiting update completed and lock state was re-verified without restarting PostgreSQL.
